title: Experimental Quantum Hardware Benchmarks of Flat Non-Clifford Hypergraph States, Antipodal Obstructions, and Nonlocal Games on IBM Heron r2
authors: Filipe Martins Vono, Valéria Gonzaga Santos, André Oliveira Naufel de Toledo
summary: We present experimental demonstrations of non-Clifford hypergraph states and nonlocal games on 156-qubit IBM Heron processors using a Lean 4-verified framework.

title: The hitting time index: bounds, a sharp threshold, the proof of a conjecture and the disproof of another conjecture
authors: José Luis Palacios, Shunya Tamura, Jason Wiberg et al.
summary: We establish new bounds for the hitting time index of a graph, proving one conjecture on its minimum value and disproving another regarding its maximum.

title: Gravitational collapse to extremal black holes with $Λ>0$: counterexamples to the third law without charge
summary: We prove the existence of regular Cauchy data leading to the formation of an extremal Schwarzschild-de Sitter black hole in finite time.

title: Sharp constant in 2D critical fermionic Hardy inequality
summary: We prove a conjecture on the large-N behavior of the optimal constant in the two-dimensional fermionic many-particle Hardy inequality.

title: Regularity Criteria for Ind-Sheaves
summary: The authors prove the Kashiwara-Schapira regularity conjecture for ind-sheaves in arbitrary dimension and relate them to regular holonomic D-modules.

title: Cell-Type-Specific Expression Is Hard to Predict from Bulk, but It Is Still Useful
authors: Gadi Naveh, Amit Miller, Gal Keinan
summary: The paper derives closed-form accuracy bounds, including an R2 ceiling for per-gene linear estimators, to explain why cell-type-specific expression is much harder to predict from bulk RNA than cell proportions.

title: Cosmological rigidity in $3$ spacetime dimensions
authors: Gregory J. Galloway, Eric Ling, Argam Ohanyan
summary: Under null geodesic completeness and the dominant energy condition, the authors establish rigidity theorems showing that cosmological spacetimes in 3 dimensions have spherical spatial topology or split as a product.

title: Modelling and Calibration of Climate-Related Credit Risk Under the Emissions Trading System
summary: The authors develop a structural credit risk model for firms facing an emission trading system, proving equilibrium carbon price existence and characterizing cap binding and optimal firm emissions.

title: Interactive Proofs as a Unified Framework for Evaluating and Leveraging Verifiable Proof Generation by LLM Agents
authors: Yankai Shu, Xingyu Zhao, Chuan Mao et al.
summary: The paper introduces Merlin-Bench, a protocol-agnostic evaluation framework based on interactive proof systems, to assess the ability of LLM agents to generate independently verifiable proofs.

title: Logarithmic scalar soft factorization from matching conditions
authors: Matías Briceño, Hernán A. González, Oriana Labrin
summary: The authors show that logarithmic soft factorization for a massless scalar coupled to massive fermions follows from asymptotic field equations and matching conditions at spatial infinity.

title: Toward a human-friendly proof of a polynomial bound for the Directed Grid Theorem
authors: Victor Campos, Allen Ibiapina, Raul Lopes et al.
summary: The authors prove each stage of the Directed Grid Theorem with a polynomial bound, reducing the function to a polynomial of degree 20031.

title: Noise threshold for learning with quantum memory
authors: Miaojiang Chen, Wenjing Xiao, Haiqiang Chen et al.
summary: The authors prove that no protocol with an entangled probe gains an exponential quantum memory advantage when the Pauli noise eigenvalue sum is at most one.

title: Superconformal Index Identities for Dual Gauge Theories
authors: Min-xin Huang, Gao-fu Ren, Xin Wang
summary: The authors prove the equality of flavored Schur indices predicted by S-duality for three classes of dual four-dimensional gauge theories using Rains's diagonal trace transformation.

title: Extension complexity is not additive under Cartesian products
summary: We prove that the linear extension complexity of a Cartesian product of polytopes can be strictly smaller than the sum of the extension complexities of its factors, disproving a known conjecture.

title: The transverse spin-gradient approximation in noncollinear spin density functional theory
summary: We prove a quantitative error bound for a fixed-axis variant of the transverse spin-gradient approximation in noncollinear spin density functional theory using a spin-spiral wave reference.

title: Defect Correlators from Supergravity: Finding the Missing Contact Terms
summary: We resolve a discrepancy in holographic defect correlators from supergravity by accounting for nonlinear Kaluza-Klein field redefinitions and off-shell terms in mixed bulk-defect vertices.

title: Exact monogamy of steering and remote Wigner negativity for multimode Gaussian nodes
summary: We show that for Gaussian states in optical quantum networks, a node with $k$ modes can be steered by exactly $2k-1$ neighbors when using Gaussian measurements.

title: Rugosity as a measurement-induced relative entropy
authors: Lucas Chibebe Céleri, Diogo de Oliveira Soares-Pinto
summary: We show that quantum-state rugosity equals the classical relative entropy generated by the binary flat-state measurement, yielding exact finite-copy and asymptotic hypothesis-testing interpretations.

title: Monoidal analog of cluster-tilting theory and monoidal reachability of acyclic cluster algebras
summary: We prove that many facts of cluster-tilting theory hold in monoidal categories from quantum affine or quiver Hecke algebras, showing maximal commuting real prime families are laurent families.

title: When to Trust a PFN: Detecting Harmful Shift in Tabular Foundation Models
authors: Viet Nguyen, Herman Bergström, Stephan Rabanser et al.
summary: We propose CALD, a lightweight unsupervised monitor for tabular foundation models, and prove that the post-finetune anchor loss has a strictly lower expectation on ID data than OOD data.

title: Ramification divisors and twisted Nambu brackets of Keller maps
authors: Geoffrey Mboya, Stephen Mboya, Carringtone Kinyanjui
summary: For polynomial maps, we study the Yau twist of the Jacobian Nambu bracket, showing the twist detects ramification divisors and characterizes automorphisms among Keller maps.

title: Generic non-convergence of low-temperature Ising Glauber dynamics on $\mathbb Z^2$
summary: We show that for low-temperature Ising Glauber dynamics on Z^2, initial laws with non-convergent weak subsequential limits form a dense G_delta subset, making convergent initial laws meagre.

title: Random dyadic shift scattering: scale-uniform deformation stability and phase-aligned Hilbert multipliers
summary: We study the deformation stability and covariance error of lattice-averaged dyadic shifts and wavelet scattering features, demonstrating bounds without L-infinity norm terms.

title: A microscopic continuum model for moiré transition metal dichalcogenides
authors: Julian Ingham, Harshitra Mahalingam, Raquel Queiroz
summary: We provide a microscopic derivation of an angle-independent continuum model accurately describing the bandstructure and tunneling paths of twisted transition metal dichalcogenides.

title: The Price of Quantum Advantage in Computational Chemistry
authors: Haejung Koh, Katerina Gratsea, Hao Zhang et al.
summary: We assess practical quantum advantage by comparing classical configuration interaction solvers with fault-tolerant resource estimates across 26 benchmark instances in computational chemistry.

title: Bound magic in multi-qubit systems
authors: Jonas Kitzinger, Jens Eisert, Ravi Kunjwal
summary: We prove the existence of multi-qubit bound magic states from which no pure magic can be distilled and introduce a PPT analogue for magic in multi-qubit systems.

title: Real equiangular lines in dimensions 18-20 and sharp fixed-angle bounds
authors: Valjakas Djaljapayan, Zhen-Qi Liao, Wei-Hsuan Yu
summary: We prove that the maximum numbers of real equiangular lines in dimensions 18, 19, and 20 are 57, 72, and 90 using lattice sections and root-system estimates.

title: Efficient Data Fusion in Distributionally Robust Optimization
authors: Buse Şen, Aras Selvi, Jean Pauphilet et al.
summary: Distributionally robust optimization can fuse fragmented evidence by constructing one ambiguity set per source and hedging against all distributions in the intersection, though exact reformulations grow exponentially with the number of sources.

title: State convertibility in quantum-state texture from a general form of free operations
summary: We derive the exact criterion for state convertibility of mixed states in quantum-state texture by completely characterizing free operations in arbitrary finite dimensions.

title: The Vinogradov system in finite fields and two-source extractors with arbitrarily small min-entropy rate
summary: We show an upper bound on the number of solutions to the Vinogradov system of degree k in 2s variables for sets in finite fields with a specified density.

title: A Pole-Cut Formula for Holographic Extremal Correlators
authors: Jyotirmoy Bhattacharya, Amiya Mishra, Aditya Sharma et al.
summary: We show that the holographic spectral function of a neutral massless scalar on the extremal Reissner-Nordstrom black brane in AdS5 admits an explicit formula in terms of quasi-normal modes and branch-cut data.

title: Discotic columnar phase in a three-dimensional monomer-tetramer model of Heilmann and Lieb with side-to-side attraction
summary: We establish discotic columnar order throughout the conjectured regime for Model III of Heilmann-Lieb, proving the existence of twelve extremal and periodic Gibbs measures.

title: $\mathsf{AC}^0 \not\subseteq \mathsf{BQAC}^0/\mathsf{qpoly}$ via Sublinear-Degree Pauli Approximation
summary: We prove AC0 is not contained in BQAC0/qpoly in the single-copy, single-output model via an explicit P-uniform family of linear-size monotone depth-2 CNFs.

title: The type I conjecture for locally compact groups acting on trees
summary: We prove that a closed group of automorphisms acting minimally on a locally finite tree and two-transitively on its boundary is of type I, solving Nebbia's conjecture.

title: Tokenisation is not in APX
authors: Violeta Kastreva, Philip Whittington, Dennis Komm et al.
summary: We prove that no polynomial-time algorithm can find a tokeniser whose objective is within any constant factor of the optimum unless P=NP, meaning tokenisation is not in APX.

title: The Reliability Function of Error-Correcting Output Codes with Noisy Binary Classifiers
authors: Gendo Kumoi, Hideki Yagi, Manabu Kobayashi et al.
summary: We derive upper and lower bounds on the excess error rate of error-correcting output codes with noisy binary classifiers, showing that a large Hamming distance is necessary and sufficient to reduce error.

title: AI-assisted formal proofs for static and time-dependent density functional theory on lattices
authors: Miguel A. L. Marques, Irene D'Amico, Stefano Pittalis
summary: We prove that on connected lattices, potentials whose ground state is shared with another potential differing by more than a constant form a closed, nowhere dense set of zero Lebesgue measure.

title: How Far Apart Are Two Proofs? Measuring Proof Dissimilarity in a Proof Kernel and in Lean/Mathlib
summary: We investigate how to measure distances between machine-generated proofs and analyze the shape of the proof space in proof kernels and Lean.

title: When Is Product Decoding of ECOC MAP-Consistent? Pair Structure and the n-vs-Rest Codes
summary: We determine which code matrices ensure that the product decoder of error-correcting output codes always agrees with the Bayes-optimal class in the noiseless setting.

title: From Fermions to Vortices: Microscopic Simulations of Phase Ordering in a d-Wave Superconductor
summary: We develop a microscopic framework using the adiabatic variational principle to simulate bath-induced superconducting phase ordering directly from a fermionic Hamiltonian in a d-wave superconductor.

title: The Wilson-loop formulation of Yang-Mills at finite mode truncation: a Level-Two structural bypass of the Gribov ambiguity
summary: We formulate truncated Yang-Mills theory using Wilson loops as fundamental variables, entirely bypassing gauge fields and the Gribov ambiguity with machine-checked proofs in Lean 4.

title: Polynomial-Time Learning of Random Automata from One Label per Word
summary: We present a polynomial-time algorithm for learning random binary deterministic finite automata from single-bit labeled uniform words with high probability.

title: Classical algorithms for sparse random Hamiltonians via free probability
authors: Matthew Ding, Robbie King, Thomas Schuster
summary: We design a classical algorithm using free probability for sparse random non-local Hamiltonians to accurately compute spectral fluctuations, thermal values, and time dynamics.

title: Verified Proof Refactoring with Codex and Qwen
authors: Lazar Milikic, Gordan Đurić, Viktor Kunčak
summary: We refactor existing Lean 4 proofs to reduce source length and checking cost while preserving theorem statements and compatibility across Lean versions.

title: E(n)-Equivariant Spherical Decision Surfaces
authors: Pavlo Melnyk, Michael Felsberg, Kostas Daniilidis
summary: We present a constructive derivation of exactly E(n)-equivariant spherical decision surfaces by extending prior O(n)-equivariant hypersphere neurons to include translations.

title: Validity and maximum violation of the entanglement-assisted quantum Singleton bound for linear stabilizer codes
authors: Jae-Hyun Baek, Byung-Sun Won, Jon-Lark Kim
summary: For linear entanglement-assisted stabilizer codes, we determine when the entanglement-assisted quantum Singleton bound holds and how far it can fail.

title: Mass gap for finite connections in supercritical percolation
summary: We prove that finite open clusters in Bernoulli bond percolation on Z^d at supercritical values are populated at positive density by renewal points except with exponentially small probability.

title: Density elimination for weakly commutative pseudo-uninorm logic:a correction and an explicit theory-level completeness proof
summary: We correct the density-elimination argument for weakly commutative pseudo-uninorm logic and provide an explicit theory-level completeness proof.

title: Upper and lower bounds for the critical point of the three-dimensional Ising model
summary: We prove sharp rigorous bounds for the critical point of the nearest-neighbour Ising ferromagnet on Z^3 using explicit rational numbers.

title: BPS baryonic tubes in chiral perturbation theory minimally coupled with electrodynamics and a novel crossover
authors: Fabrizio Canfora, Martín Garrido, Pablo Pais
summary: We derive a novel first-order BPS system in chiral perturbation theory describing baryonic tubes carrying a chiral current, providing exact solutions that differ qualitatively from previous analytic descriptions.

title: Local Indices Are Not Enough: Synchrony and Global Information in Bandit Algorithms
summary: This paper investigates the fundamental limits of asynchronous local index bandit algorithms, exploring the necessity of global information and synchronous index updates to achieve optimal regret.

title: Rough log-normal stochastic volatility with quadratic drift: second-moment stability and the martingale property under positive correlation
summary: We extend the log-normal stochastic volatility model with quadratic drift to a fractional Volterra equation, providing exact thresholds for uniformly bounded second moments and the martingale property.

title: A lower bound on the Nusselt number in stochastically forced Rayleigh--Bénard convection
summary: We establish a rigorous lower bound on the expected long-time averaged Nusselt number for two-dimensional Rayleigh-Bénard convection at infinite Prandtl number with free-slip boundaries and additive noise.

title: Dark Matter Assisted Axion-Magnetic Resonance
authors: Chen Sun, Si-Yu Wu, Seokhoon Yun
summary: We analyze how an oscillating axion dark matter background enhances the conversion of relativistic axions into photons through magnetic resonance and apply it to stellar axions in M82.

title: Winning and losing NoGo is PSPACE-complete
authors: Kyle Burke, Alfie Davies, Craig Tennenhouse
summary: We resolve an open problem by proving that the combinatorial game NoGo is PSPACE-complete on grids under both normal and misère play, and under normal play on connected bipartite subcubic graphs.

title: The Anatomy of Piecewise-Linear Learned Indexes
summary: We analyze the theoretical properties of piecewise-linear learned indexes, establishing bounds on segment coverage and addressing recursive layer behaviors.

title: A Classification of Trees Without Unique Subgraphs
summary: We develop a covering framework to study trees without unique induced subgraphs, proving that a tree is anchor-free if and only if it is a path with one less vertex than a prime.

title: A sharp form of Welsh's log-concavity inequality for chromatic polynomials
summary: We prove that Welsh's log-concavity inequality for chromatic polynomials holds for all real numbers x >= n - 1.

title: A degree-sum condition for paths through prescribed vertices
summary: We prove a degree-sum condition ensuring a path containing all vertices of a prescribed set S, yielding a path version of Ota's theorem and resolving a known conjecture.

title: U-Statistics-Powered LLM Reasoning
authors: Shijin Gong, Kai Ye, Victor Chernozhukov et al.
summary: We recast the selection of the group size in GRPO algorithms as a classical statistical problem of variance ratio estimation by exploiting its U-statistic structure.

title: On Presburger Arithmetic Expanded with Prime Numbers
summary: We prove unconditionally that the first-order theory of Presburger arithmetic expanded by a predicate for the primes is undecidable.

title: On the Fujii conjectures
summary: We disprove Fujii's first conjecture on exponential weights and prove his second conjecture on iterated weights using the Riemann hypothesis.

title: PAC-style Bounds on the Conditional Validity of Conformal Predictors
summary: We derive PAC-type probabilistic lower bounds on the input-conditional coverage of any conformal predictor without distribution assumptions.

title: Cup products with volume classes in bounded cohomology
summary: We prove that every top-degree bounded differential form in negatively curved or locally symmetric spaces belongs to the annihilator of the cup product.

title: Hardy and BMO spaces for the Laplacian with drift
authors: The Anh Bui, Fu Ken Ly
summary: We study Hardy and BMO spaces associated with the Laplacian with drift, proving the John-Nirenberg inequality and Hardy-BMO duality.

title: A proof of the toughness conjecture for Kneser graphs
summary: We resolve the toughness conjecture for Kneser graphs for all valid parameter ranges.

title: Spectrality of additive measures with Bernoulli convolutions
summary: We construct explicit spectra for Cantor-type additive measures generated by Bernoulli convolutions.

title: Degree-bounded Satisfiability of Local MPNNs with Sum Aggregation is NEXPTIME-hard
summary: We prove that the degree-bounded satisfiability problem of local MPNNs with sum aggregation is NEXPTIME-hard.

title: Finiteness and completeness of $g$-fans for real-weighted quivers
summary: We study finiteness and completeness of g-fans for quivers with positive real weights, characterizing finite Coxeter type and proving that g-finiteness implies finite Coxeter type.

title: A canonical Euclidean Gallai theorem
summary: We prove a canonical Euclidean Gallai theorem showing that any coloring of R^d contains a scaled and rotated copy of a finite point set that is monochromatic or rainbow.

title: Brauer classes of representations of division algebras and their Langlands parameters
summary: We prove that Brauer obstructions to realizing Jacquet-Langlands transfers and normalized Langlands parameters over their common field of rationality sum to a specific quaternion algebra tensor product.

title: Large blow-ups of uniform hypergraphs
summary: We prove that every sufficiently large n-vertex k-uniform hypergraph with at least an^h copies of a fixed hypergraph contains a blow-up with polylogarithmic vertices, answering a 1976 conjecture.

title: One-Relator Products of Left-Orderable Groups
authors: Alba González, Tejas Mittal, Andrew Wood
summary: We prove that one-relator products of left-orderable groups are torsion-free for non-conjugate, non-proper power words, answering a question of Chen and Lodha.

title: $S$-preclones and the Galois connection ${}^S\mathrm{Pol}$-${}^S\mathrm{Inv}$, Part II: Boolean $\pm$-preclones
authors: Peter Jipsen, Erkko Lehtonen, Reinhard Pöschel
summary: We classify all maximal and minimal Boolean +-preclones, yielding a completeness theorem for +-operations.

title: The Poissonian limit of a model inspired by the one-dimensional ERAP, and its application to satellite data
authors: Matteo D'Achille, Jessie Levillain, Pascal Moyal et al.
summary: We prove that the total number of consecutive swaps in a shifted particle tracking model converges in distribution to a Poisson random variable under specific scaling limits.

title: Positive recurrence of weakly reversible stochastic reaction networks with mass-action kinetics
summary: We prove that the Markov chain of every finite weakly reversible stochastic reaction network with mass-action kinetics is non-explosive and positive recurrent, settling the long-standing chemical recurrence conjecture.

title: An Asymptotically Sharp Form of the Overfull Conjecture
summary: We prove an asymptotically sharp form of the Overfull Conjecture for graphs with large maximum degree, advancing fundamental understanding of graph coloring.

title: On the generalized foliated cone theorem of rank one
summary: We prove the cone theorem for generalized foliated quadruples of rank one in arbitrary dimension and establish the uniqueness of MMP outputs.

title: Dobrowolski-type lower bounds for canonical heights of polynomials of Frobenius type
summary: We derive Dobrowolski-type lower bounds for canonical heights of polynomials of Frobenius type, making progress towards the dynamical Lehmer conjecture.

title: The sharp uniqueness threshold for the antiferromagnetic Potts model on regular trees
authors: Wei Wu, Yicheng Xu, Kuan Yang
summary: We determine the exact sharp Gibbs uniqueness threshold for the antiferromagnetic Potts model on regular trees, completing the classification for all parameters.

title: Arithmetic Siegel-Weil formulas for unitary Shimura varieties with Iwahori levels
authors: Sungyoon Cho, Qiao He, Chul-hee Lee et al.
summary: We formulate and partially prove conjectural arithmetic Siegel-Weil formulas and a Kudla-Rapoport conjecture for unitary Shimura varieties with Iwahori level structures.

title: How to facet a gemstone: from potential modularity to modularity lifting
summary: We prove modularity lifting for potentially modular p-adic representations without multiplicity-free or Steinberg weight hypotheses.

title: A Proof of the Balister-Győri-Schelp Conjecture on Perfect Matchings with Prescribed Differences
summary: We prove the conjecture of Balister, Győri, and Schelp concerning perfect matchings with prescribed differences in the hypercube space over finite fields.

title: Relaxation dynamics of the impurity momentum in a one-dimensional Fermi gas
summary: Using determinant overlaps between interacting eigenstates and free-fermion states, we derive closed determinant formulas for impurity momentum matrix elements in a one-dimensional Fermi gas and prove an infinite-coupling selection rule.

title: The centre of mass of the primes and a reflection of Chebyshev's bias
summary: We prove a tight bound on the distance between the centre of mass of primes and its logarithmic integral approximation, showing that the Riemann hypothesis is equivalent to a specific error estimate.

title: Low-Degree Torus Approximations of the AND Function and $\mathsf{ACC}^0$ Circuits
summary: We prove optimal degree upper bounds for torus polynomials approximating the AND function, improving previous results and refuting two superlogarithmic-degree conjectures.

title: Integral Hodge/Tate conjecture of quotients via weak approximation
summary: We prove that the rational quotient map induces a surjection on Kato homology for specific group actions on varieties, descending the integral Hodge and Tate conjectures to quotient models.

title: Classical sampling of verifiable graph-state quantum advantage experiments
authors: Zhongpu Qiu, Yuqi Qing, Jielan Li et al.
summary: We show that recent quantum advantage experiments based on verifiable graph states can be efficiently and classically sampled on GPUs with higher quality.

title: Noncommutative $\mathcal{R}(p,q)-$deformed beta functions of first and second kind : beta gamma relations, shift identities and symmetrisation
authors: Kawèyim Lankpetre, Isiaka Aremua, Joseph Désiré Bukweli Kyemba
summary: We develop the theory of beta functions attached to $\mathcal{R}(p,q)$-deformed quantum algebras, defining first and second kind beta functions and establishing shift identities and symmetrisation results.

title: Best Arm Identification with Unknown Post-Action Context Distribution
authors: Amir Mohammad Abouei, Mohammad Shahverdikondori, Emad Emamjomeh et al.
summary: We study best arm identification with post-action context in the fixed-confidence setting where the distribution of contexts given actions is unknown, and derive instance-dependent sample complexity bounds.

title: Inflation at strong mixing as a connection problem: effective field theory, Stokes phenomenon and the cosmological collider
authors: Sebastian Garcia-Saenz, Yizhou Lu, Sébastien Renaux-Petel
summary: We study a massive field strongly mixed with the curvature perturbation during inflation, solving the associated connection problem with a general method that does not rely on an exact solution.

title: Semivariance and Semivolatility in Portfolio Selection: A Unified Framework for Downside-Risk Portfolio Models
authors: Francesco Cesarone, Massimiliano Corradini, Nicolò Giunta
summary: We study downside risk in portfolio selection using semivariance and semivolatility, classifying portfolio models by the degree of positive homogeneity of the risk measure in the weights.

title: Breaking Resonance: Square-root acceleration for Metropolis-adjusted randomized Hamiltonian Monte Carlo
summary: We prove that Metropolis-adjusted Hamiltonian Monte Carlo with velocity Verlet and random integration times mixes from a warm start in a number of transitions independent of the condition number.

title: Eliminating Incompatibility in Quantum Multiparameter Estimation with Antiparallel Probes
authors: Souradeep Sasmal, Bakmou Lahcen, Kok Chuan Tan
summary: We show that antiparallel probe configurations can overcome fundamental constraints of measurement incompatibility in simultaneous quantum multiparameter estimation and saturate the Cramér-Rao bound.

title: The backtrackless circuits of $D(k,q)$ obtained by lifting
authors: Xiaoyan Cheng, Chen Zhang, Yuansheng Tang et al.
summary: We study backtrackless circuits of algebraic bipartite graphs obtained by lifting, contributing to the understanding of the exact girth conjecture for $D(k,q)$ graphs.

title: Poisson Statistics for Values of Binary Quadratic Forms in Short Intervals
summary: We formulate a Hardy-Littlewood prime k-tuple conjecture analogue for integers represented by binary quadratic forms and show it implies Poisson statistics for value counts in short intervals.

title: The optimal exponent in the Babai-Goodman-Pyber theorem
summary: We determine the exact optimal exponent c in the Babai-Goodman-Pyber theorem bounding the index of the soluble radical in a finite group.

title: Strong hyperbolicity of puncture-gauge formulations of gravitational theories with second order equations of motion
summary: We prove that puncture-gauge formulations of Einstein-Gauss-Bonnet gravity and four-derivative scalar-tensor theory are strongly hyperbolic at sufficiently weak coupling under specific gauge conditions.

title: The smallest singular value of a random sign matrix: the Spielman-Teng conjecture
summary: We prove the Spielman-Teng conjecture regarding the probability bound for the smallest singular value of a random sign matrix.

title: Exact solution of the Bose-Fermi mixture along the unnesting line
authors: Soham Chandak, Aleksandra Petković, Zoran Ristivojevic
summary: We obtain exact analytical results for the ground-state energy, excitation velocities, and Drude weights of a one-dimensional Bose-Fermi mixture along an unnested Bethe-ansatz line.

title: The Generalized Volterra Signature
authors: Munawar Ali, Qi Feng, Samy Tindel
summary: We introduce the generalized Volterra signature of a path, establish a new algebraic structure to encode it, and prove a generalized Chen's identity along with shuffle products for geometric components.

title: InstructReplay: Replaying Assistant Turns to Preserve General Behavior During Factual Fine-Tuning
authors: Xiaofeng Shi, Qian Kou, Hua Zhou
summary: Fine-tuning language models on new facts causes a severe collapse in reasoning and length, which can be mitigated by replaying initial model answers during training.

title: Conformality lost in Anderson localization in infinite dimensions, and regained in finite dimensions: a phenomenological theory of the Anderson transition in high dimensions
summary: We frame high-dimensional Anderson localization into the 'conformality lost' scenario where RG fixed points collide, enabling a BKT-like scaling flow and an epsilon expansion.

title: Delta-Vega Hedging with Deep Reinforcement Learning: From Simulation to Reality
authors: Michele Colombi, Marco Di Francesco, Pietro Rossi
summary: We propose a deep reinforcement learning approach using PPO to hedge price and volatility risk with the underlying asset and a longer-dated option under transaction costs.

title: Modular Schur functions and Macdonald characters
summary: We prove three results about modular Schur functions: bases for specific symmetric polynomials, the signs and bounds of their Schur coefficients, and characterizations.

title: Shared information governs multi-view planted matching
summary: We study multi-view planted matching and show that all views can be matched up to o(n) errors if the shared information exceeds a specific log threshold.

title: Analytic response functions of space-based gravitational-wave detectors to ultralight scalar-field dark matter under multiple types of TDI combinations
authors: Wenqiu Tang, Pan-Pan Wang, Yuezhe Chen et al.
summary: We derive analytic expressions for the response functions of space-based gravitational-wave detectors to ultralight scalar-field dark matter under multiple TDI combinations.

title: Schubert positivity for filtered bundles
summary: We characterize formal filtered nefness of quotient flags, prove quotient Schubert functors preserve it, and extend the Lorentzian polynomial theorem to derived Schubert classes.

title: Differential Equations for Feynman Integrals from Higher Residue Pairings
authors: Giacomo Brunello, Vsevolod Chestnov, Ben Page
summary: We develop a method for constructing differential equations for Feynman integrals directly from multivariate intersection numbers using higher residue pairings.

title: Fractional Triangular Maximal Operators on Locally Finite Trees
summary: We introduce centered and uncentered fractional triangular maximal operators on locally finite trees, establishing geometric tools, pointwise comparisons, and sharp bounds.

title: On Lipschitz equicontinuity of random Schrödinger operators on lattices
summary: We prove that the density of states for random Schrödinger operators on lattices is uniformly bounded in the coupling strength for a dense set of single site probability distributions.

title: Normal edge-transitive bi-Cayley graphs of prime valency over nonabelian simple groups
authors: Zai Ping Lu, Hai Ze Wang
summary: We prove that if the normalizer of a semiregular nonabelian simple group in the automorphism group of a connected prime-valency graph is edge-transitive, then the graph is bipartite and the group is characteristic.

title: Classifying exact local-equilibrium solutions of the Boltzmann equation
summary: We provide a complete classification of all hydrodynamic states and external forces for which a local equilibrium distribution is an exact solution to the Boltzmann kinetic equation.

title: Spectral characterizations of sub-Gaussian heat kernel bounds
summary: We provide a counterexample on the Euclidean plane disproving a conjecture about whether Faber-Krahn inequalities and Dirichlet spectrum bounds characterize sub-Gaussian heat kernel upper bounds.

title: Second-order asymptotics for the quantum and private capacities of the erasure channel
summary: We determine the optimal second-order coding rates for the quantum and private capacities of the erasure channel for input dimension at least two and fixed infidelity.

title: Quantum Coherence and Basis-Dependent Correlations in Quantum Systems
authors: Zi-Han Chen, Hui Zhao, Shao-Ming Fei et al.
summary: We analyze bipartite states where the amount of quantum coherence in the global state equals that in the reduced states, identifying the conditions under which basis-dependent correlations vanish.

title: Entanglement between distant spins in a polarized magnet forms a $d$-wave clover
summary: We prove that spin-orbit coupling in a polarized spin-1/2 square-lattice ferromagnet generates a leading-order d-wave inverse-square entanglement law forming a clover-shaped region between distant spins.

title: Group classification of a class of systems of nonlinear diffusion equations. I
authors: Oleksandr A. Voloshyn, Mykola I. Serov, Olena O. Vaneeva
summary: We find the equivalence algebra and kernel of maximal Lie invariance algebras for a class of (1+1)-dimensional nonlinear diffusion equations and classify nine inequivalent subclasses admitting symmetry extensions.

title: Environmentally assisted transport in a diamond chain
authors: Pavel S. Muraev, Andrey R. Kolovsky, Dmitrii N. Maksimov
summary: We derive exact analytical solutions for quantum transport in a diamond chain and show that dephasing destroys Aharonov-Bohm caging in the flat-band regime, producing environment-assisted transport.

title: A proof of the Nevo-Peeva conjecture: Exact regularity and linear powers of gap-free edge ideals
summary: We prove that if a finite simple graph is gap-free, its edge ideal regularity recurrence holds with equality and determines when it has a linear resolution.

title: Differentiability of the shape function in the planar corner growth model
authors: Christopher Janjigian, Firas Rassoul-Agha, Timo Seppäläinen
summary: The shape function of planar directed last-passage percolation with general i.i.d. weights is proved to be differentiable on the open first quadrant under specific moment assumptions.

title: The generalized Segal conjecture and the coalgebraic Frobenius
summary: We prove the generalized Segal conjecture by showing that the Hill-Hopkins-Ravenel norm of a spectrum becomes Borel-complete after completion at the augmentation ideal of the Burnside ring.

title: Nash-Williams' Orientation Theorems for Infinite Graphs
authors: Amena Assem, Mohammad A. Mahmoud, Bobby Miraftab
summary: We establish orientation theorems for infinite graphs, addressing longstanding conjectures regarding well-balanced and $k$-arc-connected orientations.

title: Stark units and cyclotomic Iwasawa theory over complex cubic fields
summary: For cyclotomic extensions of complex cubic fields, we prove the integral rank-1 and rational rank-2 abelian Stark conjectures and an Iwasawa main conjecture relating Stark units to ideal class groups.

title: Environmental resonances in extreme-mass-ratio inspirals within boson clouds
summary: Using a multiparameter expansion and the action-angle formalism, we derive a general resonance condition for generic bound Kerr orbits in extreme-mass-ratio inspirals within boson clouds.

title: Spontaneous Time-Reversal-Symmetry-Breaking State in Proximity-Induced Superconductivity
authors: Jonathan Schirmer, Wei Pan, Javad Shabani et al.
summary: We present a minimal mechanism for a time-reversal-symmetry-breaking superconducting state in multiband systems proximity-coupled to a conventional s-wave superconductor, deriving conditions and phase diagrams.

title: A Perturbative Two-Eigenvalue Faber-Krahn Problem for the Gaussian Short-Time Fourier Transform
summary: We prove that area-maximizing sets for the weighted sum of the first two eigenvalues of Fock space Toeplitz operators are disks up to translations and measure zero sets.

title: Kovács Vanishing for Excellent Log Canonical Threefolds
summary: We prove a vanishing theorem of S. Kovacs for excellent log canonical threefolds in large characteristic and apply it to prove depth relations and resolution-invariance.

title: Quantum Subentropy: Subadditivity and Sharp Bounds on Discrimination Error
summary: We prove the subadditivity of quantum subentropy for arbitrary bipartite states in finite dimensions and derive a sharp relation between conditional subentropy and minimum discrimination error.

title: A one-third bound for domination in cubic graphs of girth at least six
authors: Kun Cheng, Changlong Shen, Leilei Zhang
summary: We prove Verstraete's conjecture that every cubic graph of order n and girth at least six satisfies the domination number bound gamma(G) <= n/3 in full.

title: Wigner negativity costs phase-space area: A conjectured refinement of the Lieb--Solovej inequality at Rényi order one half
summary: We conjecture a refinement of the Lieb-Solovej inequality relating Wigner logarithmic negativity to Rényi entropy, and show it suffices to prove it for pure states.

title: Circle-Pattern Linear Systems for the Twenty Trivalent Delaunay Types of a Genus-Two Surface: Rank, Feasibility and Polytope Dimension
summary: We prove that the rank of the angle system matrix A equals 6 for all twenty trivalent Delaunay types of a genus-two surface.

title: Symmetries, conservation laws, series solutions and singularity formation for the spherically symmetric Euler-Poisson equations in mass coordinates
summary: We determine all point symmetries of the spherically symmetric Euler-Poisson equations in mass coordinates for a polytropic gas.

title: Super-Multiplicativity of the Noncommutative Minimum and Applications to Quantum Privacy and Hypothesis Testing
authors: Theshani Nuradha, Sujeet Bhalerao, Christoph Hirche et al.
summary: We prove that the noncommutative minimum of positive semidefinite operators is super-multiplicative across tensor products.

title: The $T1$ theorem under Dini regularity
summary: The authors prove the T1 theorem for Calderón-Zygmund operators under the classical Dini regularity condition, solving a longstanding open problem in singular integral theory.

title: Disc functionals and rational curves
authors: Yinji Li, Haoyuan Sun, Zhiwei Wang et al.
summary: We prove a criterion for the existence of rational curves on compact Kähler manifolds using disc functionals, obtaining a transcendental version of the Miyaoka-Mori theorem.

title: Perfect Spin-to-Charge Signal Conversion via Inverse Spin Hall Effect in a Superconductor
authors: Rodrigo de las Heras, Ilya V. Tokatly, F. Sebastian Bergeret
summary: We show that superconductivity can overcome limitations of the conventional spin Hall effect and enable near-unity spin-to-charge signal conversion in a nonlocal spin-valve geometry.

title: Linear forms in logarithms of rational numbers: an ineffective measure with the best possible exponent
summary: We establish an ineffective measure with the best possible exponent for linear forms in logarithms of rational numbers using induction on n.

title: The optimal exponent in the Erdős--Fuchs theorem for $k$-fold sums
summary: The authors prove that a specific lower bound form for $r_k(A,x)$ is impossible for any $c>0$, obtain a mean-square estimate, and confirm a conjecture of Chen and Tang for $k\ge 3$.

title: Geometric Polarization-Virial Theorems for Field-Induced Dipolar Interactions and Force Reversal
summary: Researchers uncover an entropy-like geometric structure where the cubically weighted interaction free energy is nondecreasing under physical dilation, unifying two exact polarization-virial theorems.

title: Monsky's nodal cubic and the arithmetic of Frobenius invariants
summary: The paper proves Monsky's conjecture on ideal colengths in polynomial rings and analyzes the algebraic and transcendental nature of Hilbert-Kunz and Frobenius splitting series.

title: Optimal Statistic for a Stochastic Gravitational Wave Background using Pulsar-Timing--Astrometry Cross Correlations
authors: Kimberly K. Boddy, Jeffrey S. Hazboun, Kris Pardo
summary: The study develops a correlation statistic between pairs of stellar deflections for astrometry to search for a stochastic gravitational wave background.

title: Local Limits and Structures of Nearest-Predecessor Random Graphs
summary: The authors construct an infinite graph limit for nearest-predecessor random graphs, prove its Benjamini-Schramm convergence, and resolve Ponomarenko's open problem regarding the maximum degree.

title: Symmetry breaking Poincar{é}--Einstein metrics and non-extendable boundary Killing fields
summary: Poincaré-Einstein metrics are constructed that bifurcate from anti-de Sitter black holes and break rotational symmetry while keeping conformal infinity fixed.

title: Cylindrical dimers and monomial immanants
summary: The authors prove that every minor of a Toeplitz matrix formed by cylindrical dimer matchings has nonnegative coefficients, settling a question by Lai and connecting to Stembridge's conjecture.

title: Precise Asymptotics of Non-Convex M-Estimators
authors: Shirley Xiaoqi Liu, Tirthankar Adhikari, Parthe Pandit
summary: The paper analyzes non-convex M-estimation in generalized linear models under rotationally invariant designs using Vector Approximate Message Passing and State Evolution.

title: Central charges as black-hole hair in weakly coupled trace-anomaly gravity
authors: Francisco Tello-Ortiz, A. Vásquez, Kazuharu Bamba et al.
summary: The study proves that black holes in weakly coupled trace-anomaly gravity carry scalar hair whose charge is fixed by horizon topology, surface gravity, and the difference of central charges.

title: Exact finite-sample and loss limits of squeezed-vacuum phase estimation
summary: We settle the dispute over squeezed-vacuum phase estimation by exact computation of finite-sample errors, resource-fair scaling, phase window, and loss ceilings.

title: Neutron-alpha scattering on a quantum processor: Spin-orbit-split resonances and weak nonresonant channels
authors: Myeong-Hwan Mun, Jubin Park, Myung-Ki Cheoun et al.
summary: We reconstruct elastic neutron-alpha phase shifts in all five channels through l=2 from trapped spectra measured on a quantum computer.

title: $K3$ Picard--Fuchs equations with initial conditions in the Hodge line
summary: We prove Lam and Litt's conjecture for families of K3 surfaces over a finitely generated Z-algebra when the initial condition lies in the Hodge line.

title: Zariski-constructible functions of class $\mathcal{C}^k$
authors: Jean-Baptiste Campesato, Jean-Philippe Monnier, Enrico Savi
summary: We study Zariski-constructible functions of class C^k over a real closed field, where functions have graphs that are Boolean combinations of algebraic subsets.

title: Quantum walks and conformal mappings
authors: Fedor Kuyanov, Michael Drmota, Mikhail Skopenkov et al.
summary: We study quantum walks and prove two general theorems producing uniform asymptotic formulae for the wave function, observing a transition governed by the gamma function.

title: Evidence Toward a Conjecture in List Recoverability of Folded Reed--Solomon Codes
authors: Yeyuan Chen, Mahdi Cheraghchi, King-Siong Si et al.
summary: We provide new evidence toward a recent conjecture on the list-recoverability of folded Reed-Solomon codes by proving explicit codes of rate close to a specific bound are list-recoverable.

title: Black-Box Comparator-Adaptive Network Regret
summary: We resolve an open question by constructing a two-node counterexample showing gossip-based algorithms can produce exponential regret, and introduce a black-box reduction.

title: Quantum-geometry-tuned Mott transition and emergent heavy fermions in a topological flat band
summary: We develop a dynamical mean-field theory for a Hubbard interaction on coherent orbitals in a topological flat band, finding a quantum-geometry-tuned Mott transition.

title: Irreducible shallow tanh neural networks are a manifold
authors: Ivan Bioli, Isabella Carla Gonnella, Carlo Marcati et al.
summary: We prove that the subset of functions represented by irreducible shallow neural networks with hyperbolic tangent activation is a smooth embedded submanifold of Sobolev spaces.

title: Grokking as a Subspace Search: Computing the Destination Before Training
authors: Sunjae Jeong, Jaeseung Kim, Hyoseok Hwang
summary: We show that on group tasks the destination of grokking can be computed before training as a low-dimensional subspace of the network's embeddings.

title: Optimal Regret Lower Bounds in Matrix Games
summary: We prove that for every deterministic learning dynamic in matrix games, there exists a payoff matrix for which the maximum individual regret is Omega of the square root of log m times log n.

title: Non-Perturbative Analysis of Resonances by a Contraction Mapping on Complex Domains
summary: By deforming the contour and constructing a contraction mapping on complex domains, we prove the existence of resonance poles for an abstract Friedrichs--Lee Hamiltonian.

title: Central limit theorem for energies of determinantal point processes on complex manifolds I
summary: We prove a central limit theorem for the Green energy of a Bergman determinantal point process by combining local Bergman kernel asymptotics with an expansion for the cumulants.

title: Uniform Ionization Bounds in Molecular Thomas--Fermi--Dirac--von Weizsäcker Theory
summary: For each fixed number of nuclei, we prove that every minimizer of mass in molecular Thomas--Fermi--Dirac--von Weizsäcker theory satisfies an upper bound dependent on nuclear charge, answering a large-charge ionization question.

title: A proof of the chemical recurrence conjecture in two dimensions
authors: Andrea Agazzi, David F. Anderson, Daniele Cappelletti et al.
summary: We prove the long-standing chemical recurrence conjecture stating that if a network of chemical reactions is weakly reversible, then it is recurrent.

title: A Characterization of Tangle Matroids
summary: We prove that a matroid with at least two elements is a tangle matroid if and only if it cannot be covered by three hyperplanes.

title: Imprints of quantum space in the ringdown phase of Kerr black holes
authors: Nikola Herceg, Tajron Jurić, A. Naveena Kumara et al.
summary: We investigate quantum-space corrections to gravitational quasinormal modes of Kerr black holes using noncommutative geometry and derive a Schrödinger-like master equation.

title: The monodromy conjecture for remarkable poles
authors: Nero Budur, Quan Shi, Huaiqing Zuo
summary: We prove the strong monodromy conjecture for the remarkable numbers of a regular function on a smooth complex variety.

title: The limit shape of uniform random antichains in $[0,1]^d$
summary: We prove that uniform random antichains in hypercubes converge in Hausdorff distance to a specific hypersurface limit shape, and derive the asymptotic expansion of the antichain probability.

title: The Tate conjecture for abelian fourfolds
summary: We prove the Tate conjecture for non-CM and non-ordinary abelian fourfolds over positive characteristic function fields, completing the conjecture for abelian fourfolds over finitely generated fields.

title: Support monotonicity for quadratically regularized optimal transport
summary: Under regularity assumptions on marginal densities and the Brenier map, we establish interior support inclusions for quadratically regularized optimal transport optimizers as regularization tends to zero.

title: Maximal sections of the cube
summary: We prove the folklore conjecture on maximal central sections of the cube in every dimension and codimension, determining sharp volumes and projection densities.

title: Massive de Sitter correlators at one loop
summary: Starting from finite Mellin-Barnes integrals, we compute exact squeezed coefficients of one-loop massive de Sitter correlators and their corrections away from the squeezed limit.

title: An Exact Vertex Localization of Zykov's Theorem
summary: We establish a vertex-based localization of the exact form of Zykov's theorem involving the number of clique copies and sizes of largest cliques containing each vertex.

title: Provability of Consistency: A New Foundational Landscape
summary: We construct a rigorous mathematical proof of the Hilbertian consistency of Peano Arithmetic that is formalizable within Peano Arithmetic itself.

title: The Relaxation of Quantum Near-Extremal Black Holes. (I) Microcanonical States, Pruning of Quasinormal Modes, and the Aretakis Instability
authors: Roberto Emparan, Sameer Murthy, Stefano Trezzi
summary: We resolve the puzzle of late-time relaxation of near-extremal black holes by computing the retarded Green's function, showing how quantum fluctuations cause each classical quasinormal mode to split into a pair of poles.

title: LeanReviewBench: Semantic Alignment Review in Mathematical Lean Projects
authors: Ruichen Qiu, Hao Shen, Lihong Zhi et al.
summary: We introduce LeanReviewBench, a benchmark for project-level semantic alignment review containing 197 versioned inputs from 18 real Lean projects to evaluate whether formal propositions preserve informal mathematical content.

title: Robust bounds for American fixed-strike lookback puts
summary: We initiate the robust pricing of American fixed-strike lookback options under martingale optimal transport constraints, identifying structural properties that separate this from European cases.

title: Cycle popping and positivity in linear Laurent phenomenon algebras
summary: We prove that every monomial in the cluster variables of a linear Laurent phenomenon algebra is a nonnegative combination of cluster monomials using Wilson's cycle popping.

title: Smale's Mean Values And Geometric Mean Values
summary: We prove the existence of polynomials with geometric mean values exceeding any bound L for degree d > 2, verify Smale's mean value conjecture for specific subclasses, and connect these values to Fekete points.

title: Idempotent generically stable measures in NSOP$_1$ groups
summary: We prove the Idempotent Measure Conjecture for type-definable groups in theories whose Keisler randomization is NSOP1.

title: On the leading constant in Manin's conjecture
authors: Stephanie Chan, Peter Koymans, Nick Rome et al.
summary: We disprove a conjecture of Batyrev and Tschinkel concerning counting rational points of bounded height, suggesting a role for the transcendental Brauer group in the leading constant.

title: Critical step size of stochastic gradient descent for a linear neuron: an exact solution and the role of the input spectrum
summary: We solve the exact stochastic gradient descent dynamics for a linear neuron with arbitrary input covariance, proving a critical step size condition and deriving the stationary error.

title: CrossCheck I: Cost Bounds of Imperative Programs as Constrained Optimization, with a Sound Cost Logic and a Verified Certificate Checker
summary: We map structured imperative control flow into constrained optimization over execution traces and computation trees, establishing a sound cost logic and verified certificate checker.

title: Safe Autoformalization: Sufficiency and Necessity with Entailment Graphs
summary: We propose techniques for safe autoformalization that certify one-sided logical adequacy using LLMs to generate candidate formulas and order them by logical strength in an Entailment Graph.

title: Spin Hamiltonian, magnetic anisotropy and excitation spectrum in altermagnetic $α$-MnTe from first principles
authors: Matteo Costa, Dario Fiore Mosca, Cesare Franchini et al.
summary: We derive the complete low-energy magnetic Hamiltonian of the altermagnet $\alpha$-MnTe from first principles, combining density functional theory and dynamical mean-field theory.

title: Ground state and thermal phase diagrams of the magnetized spin-$1/2$ XXZ antiferromagnet on the triangular lattice
authors: Owan Cho, Seungho Lee, Hyun-Yong Lee et al.
summary: Using tensor network and density-matrix renormalization group methods, we resolve the ground-state and thermal phase diagrams of the spin-1/2 XXZ antiferromagnet on the triangular lattice.

title: CrossCheck II: A Compiler Plugin for Certified Cost Bounds of Real-Time C and C++ Code, and its Evaluation
summary: We describe a Clang compiler plugin that bounds the cost of real-time C and C++ functions and emits checkable cost certificates for linear fragments.

title: Data-Driven Identification of Uncertainty Sets with Conformance Guarantees
authors: Laura Lützow, Mykel J. Kochenderfer, Matthias Althoff
summary: We present ConfID, a unified framework that establishes reachset, trace, and simulation conformance by identifying uncertainty sets for nonlinear nominal models.

title: The Residual Unitary Case for Almost Elusive Groups
summary: We remove the residual unitary family from Hall's classification of almost elusive classical groups using Zsigmondy and Schinzel theorems alongside elementary number theory arguments.

title: Tensor powers of the Steinberg character of $GL_n(\mathbb{F}_q)$, zonotopal algebras, and quiver varieties
summary: We prove that the cohomology ring of the quiver variety associated to the tensor power of the Steinberg character is generated by its tautological classes and isomorphic to a central zonotopal algebra.

title: Frieze's $ζ(3)$ and the Avram--Bertsimas constant under Haar conjugation
summary: We prove that normalized expected minimum spanning tree weights for Haar unitary matrices differ from the independent Gaussian model by a polynomially small error, recovering Frieze's zeta(3) constant.

title: A Kernel Framework for Linear Operator Equations
summary: We develop a unified numerical framework for solving linear operator equations with nonlocal terms by embedding them into a reproducing kernel Hilbert space and using Riesz representers.

title: Fake surfaces for some potential Andrews-Curtis counterexamples
summary: We construct closed fake surfaces for the Akbulut-Kirby family of Andrews-Curtis counterexamples using geodesic loops in a metric classifying space for the 3-strand braid group.

title: Counting elliptic curves by discriminant
summary: We prove an asymptotic formula for the number of Q-isomorphism classes of elliptic curves ordered by minimal discriminant, conditional on the abc conjecture, and obtain unconditional results near the cusp.

title: Contact rigidity and Poisson bracket invariants
summary: We study C0-rigidity and Poisson bracket invariants on closed contact manifolds, proving Poisson commutation is closed under uniform convergence and establishing weak rigidity and lower semicontinuity properties.

title: Gaussian Belief Propagation and Periodic Jacobi Matrices on Trees: Spectral Curve, Antibound Poles, and Fixed Points
summary: Diagonal Green functions of a periodic Jacobi operator satisfy scalar Gaussian belief propagation covariance equations, proving the conjecture of Christiansen, Simon and Zinchenko.

title: Local redundancies are necessary for long-lived memories in finite spatial dimensions
authors: Chao Yin, Yaodong Li, Benedikt Placke et al.
summary: We prove a no-go theorem for exponentially long-lived thermal memories based on the structure of local redundancies among Hamiltonian terms in finite spatial dimensions.

title: Improved Lower Bound on the Hadwiger-Debrunner Numbers
summary: We prove improved lower bounds on Hadwiger-Debrunner numbers for families of convex sets in dimension at least two.

title: On the Bourgain-Rudnick eigenfunction restriction conjecture in four dimensions
summary: We prove a uniform upper L2 bound for eigenfunctions of the four-dimensional flat torus on the compact paraboloid using Fourier restriction estimates.

title: Stopping-Time Leakage in Blind Quantum Delegation
summary: We study stopping-time leakage in blind quantum delegation and prove that the server's best distinguishing advantage equals the total-variation distance between the stopping-time distributions.

title: Gravitational waves in hierarchical triples with lensing and relativistic orbits
authors: Brian C. Seymour, Fabiano Feleppa, Luka Vujeva et al.
summary: We advance the modeling of hierarchical triple black hole systems by including new relativistic lensing, aberration, and polarization terms to compute exact gravitational waves.

title: On-demand frequency-entangled microwave biphotons from a transmon-resonator dimer
authors: E. V. Stolyarov, O. V. Kliushnichenko
summary: We propose a superconducting circuit QED source of on-demand frequency-entangled microwave photon pairs based on a transmon-resonator dimer.
